rationale: SAQ Postgres burst worker correctness hinges on concurrent dequeue (duplicate/active lost-update), burst-stop counting, poll vs dequeue_timeout wakeup, and schedule-timer visibility. Baselines plus extremes: 1-job control, 4-job concurrent dequeue race, partial max_burst_jobs with concurrency=2 for burst-counter race/early-exit, max_burst=1 with slow poll and schedule disabled for premature stop vs hang, max_burst>jobs with concurrency for off-by-one completion, and short dequeue_timeout with slow poll and schedule=3600 for missed-wakeup/lost-job on burst exit.
